sinopsis.es: Kevin es un romántico sin remedio cuyo optimismo supera por mucho su conciencia de sí mismo. De día trabaja como Online Safety Salamander en un colegio. De noche se somete a una interminable serie de citas desastrosas, convencido de que la persistencia lo llevará al amor.
sinopsis.en: Kevin is a hopelessly earnest romantic whose optimism far outweighs his self-awareness. By day, he works as a school's Online Safety Salamander. By night, he subjects himself to a relentless series of disastrous dates, convinced that persistence alone will eventually lead to love.
